pages.title: Food Families
pages.text: Foods are grouped into $(thing)families$() based on what kind of food they are — $(thing)fish$(), $(thing)bread$(), $(thing)leafy greens$(), and more.$(br2)$(bold)Eating too many foods from the same family reduces nutrition returns across that entire family$() — even if the specific items are different.

pages.title: Family Fatigue
pages.text: Salmon, cod, and tuna are all different items — but they all belong to the $(thing)fish family$().$(br2)Eating all three in quick succession builds up $(c:#e05252)fish family fatigue$(). Each fish gives less nutrition than the last, even though you technically ate three different things.$(br2)$(italic)The Diet Screen shows your most fatigued families — check it to see what you have been over-relying on.$()
